name: Kesh Mossarrow

ac.type: Carvaloth scale 14 + Dexterity capped at 2; no shield

speed: 35 ft. walk/climb/swim; 45 ft. walking on first combat turn
proficiencies: Light/medium armor, shields, simple/martial weapons; carpenter's tools, land vehicles. Archery style. Stealth from bugbear; Canny expertise. Druidic focus allowed by optional Tasha feature.
bio:
A quiet bugbear who rescued a village from its own lord's hunters and now keeps its forest paths safe. Kesh marks arrows with little carved leaves and dislikes being praised where everyone can hear. Bond: the families who hid him. Flaw: judges strangers by how quietly they move.

Enter 420 gp. Set initiative modifier +2 beyond Dexterity, giving +6 total for Dread Ambusher. Canny expertise and Iron Mind saves are included. Carvaloth sight-hiding rolls are normally straight after cancelling its normal armor disadvantage. Add +10 for Pass without Trace only while active. Track first-turn bonuses individually.

Remaining gold: 420 gp. See the build guide for native scores, sources, spending and conditional features.

traits.name: Build audit
traits.description: MPMM bugbear +2 Dex/+1 Con; Ranger 4 Piercer +1 Dex. No racial feat; house Sharpshooter has no ASI. Standard-array Str/Dex/Con/Int/Wis/Cha: 12/15/13/10/14/8. Native: 12/18/14/10/14/8. Equipped: 12/18/14/10/14/8. Average HP 60 at level 7.

traits.name: Campaign constraints
traits.description: Sharpshooter is the original 2014 house-rule feat and gives no ability-score increase. Folk Hero (PHB) grants no feat. Other feat/stat increases have their separate sources recorded. One Rare and one Uncommon item, no Renaissance/Futuristic equipment. Additional 638 gp plus background 10 gp; spent 228, remaining 420. No gear resale, free summoned creatures, pre-cast buffs or paid extra spells assumed.

traits.name: Race and feat progression
traits.description: MPMM bugbear chooses +2 Dexterity and +1 Constitution. Ranger 4 Piercer adds +1 Dexterity. House Sharpshooter is the original 2014 feat with no stat increase. Final Dex 18, Con 14. No racial feat.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: MPMM bugbear: on an attack-roll hit, +2d6 damage if the target has not yet taken a turn in the current combat. Not limited to once per turn, and does not require the surprised condition. Stops applying to a target after it has taken its first turn.

traits.name: Bugbear traits
traits.description: Darkvision 60 feet becomes 90 with Umbral Sight. Fey Ancestry gives advantage against charm. Long-Limbed adds 5 feet only to melee attacks on your turn, not bow range or off-turn reach. Powerful Build doubles ordinary carrying capacity. Sneaky grants Stealth and fitting in Small spaces without squeezing.

traits.name: Dread Ambusher
traits.description: Add Wisdom +2 to initiative for total +6. First combat turn: +10 feet walking speed and one extra weapon attack as part of the Attack action, with +1d8 damage on that additional attack if it hits. Normally two attacks; three on that first turn.

traits.name: Umbral Sight and Iron Mind
traits.description: In darkness, invisible to a creature relying on darkvision to see you there; not universal invisibility or automatic hiding. Darkvision 90 feet. Ranger 7 Iron Mind grants Wisdom saving throw proficiency, already included.

traits.name: Carvaloth Scale Armor
traits.description: Uncommon, no attunement. AC 14 + Dex capped at 2 = 16 without shield. Observers have disadvantage on Perception checks to SEE you. Its advantage on Stealth to hide FROM SIGHT cancels scale mail's normal Stealth disadvantage; such rolls are straight, not automatically advantaged. For other Stealth checks, the ordinary armor disadvantage still matters. Apply -5 to sight-based passive Perception where the disadvantage applies.

traits.name: Archery / Sharpshooter / Piercer
traits.description: Bow attack +11, or +6 for optional -5/+10. Sharpshooter ignores half/three-quarters cover and long-range disadvantage, not total cover. Piercer permits one piercing damage-die reroll per turn and one extra weapon die on a piercing critical. Apply rerolls/extra critical dice manually.

traits.name: Deft Explorer and Roving
traits.description: Optional Tasha replacements: Canny doubles Stealth proficiency and adds Elvish/Dwarvish. Roving at 6 adds 5 feet to walking and grants equal climb/swim speeds. These replace Natural Explorer rather than stacking its benefits.

traits.name: Favored Foe
traits.description: Replaces Favored Enemy. On a hit, mark with no action; add 1d6 on the first hit against that target on each of your turns at Ranger 7. Three marks per long rest, each up to 1 minute with concentration. Cannot maintain with Pass without Trace, Spike Growth or Zephyr Strike. No extra Favored Enemy languages.

traits.name: Primal Awareness / focus
traits.description: Replaces Primeval Awareness: Speak with Animals and Beast Sense are additional known spells, each free once per long rest or cast with slots. Ranger does not gain general ritual casting. Optional Spellcasting Focus allows the purchased totem for ranger spells.

traits.name: Rustic Hospitality
traits.description: Folk Hero background: common folk may provide modest shelter and help you hide or recover, unless doing so would expose them to danger. No automatic combat allies, feat or ability increase.

attacks.name: Unacted target — Sharpshooter
attacks.description: Bugbear bonus only while this target has not taken its first combat turn.

attacks.name: Dread Ambusher + unacted target — SS
attacks.description: Use only for the first-turn EXTRA attack, and only before target's first turn. Other two shots do not get the extra d8.

attacks.name: Shortsword
attacks.range: 10 ft. on your turn, 5 ft. otherwise

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.description: Create ten berries, each nourishing a creature for a day and restoring 1 HP when eaten using an action. Unused berries lose their magic after 24 hours. Eating a berry is not casting a slot spell and does not trigger Unicorn Spirit healing.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.casting_time: 1 reaction; when taking a listed elemental damage type
spells.description: Reaction to acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: gain resistance to that triggering type until your next turn. Your first MELEE attack hit on that next turn adds 1d6 of the type, +1d6 per higher slot. It does not add damage to an arrow.

spells.name: Zephyr Strike
spells.description: Bonus action and concentration: your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Once during its duration, give one weapon attack advantage; that attack adds 1d8 force on a hit and your walking speed rises 30 feet for that turn, hit or miss. Not advantage on every attack.

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.description: Concentration; you and chosen companions near you gain +10 Dexterity (Stealth) and leave no tracks except by magic. It does not make you automatically hidden, invisible, or silent.
spells.materials: ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.description: A 20-foot-radius area becomes difficult terrain; a creature moving into/within takes 2d4 piercing per 5 feet. Forced movement also triggers damage if it actually moves the creature through the area. Concentration; use the full spell's terrain-camouflage rules.
spells.materials: seven sharp thorns or seven small twigs, each sharpened to a point

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.description: Create a visual disguise. Physical contact can reveal it; an investigating creature checks against spell DC 13. Does not change your actual body or equipment.

spells.name: Rope Trick
spells.description: Create a temporary extradimensional shelter accessible by climbing a rope; observe the full spell's creature-count and rope restrictions. Attacks and spells cannot cross its entrance. No concentration.
spells.materials: powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.description: Ranger Primal Awareness: one free cast per long rest or use slots. Communicate with beasts for 10 minutes, limited by their intelligence. Ranger does not gain general ritual casting from this spell's tag.

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: Ranger Primal Awareness: one free cast per long rest or use slots. Touch a willing beast and use actions to perceive through its senses; your own sight/hearing are unavailable while doing so. Concentration. Ranger has no general ritual casting.
